identificationModule.officialTitle: The Safety and Efficacy of Rh-Endostatin (Endostar®) Continuous Intravenous Infusion in Combination With Docetaxel/Carboplatin or Pemetrexed/Carboplatin (DC/PC) Regimens for Untreated Stage IIIB/IV Non-small-cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

leadSponsor.name: Affiliated Cancer Hospital & Institute of Guangzhou Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Endostar is a anti-angiogenesis product and has been launched in China . The efficacy and safety have been defined. However, the compliance is unsatisfactory since routine i.v of Endostar is needed for 3 to 4 hours daily during one cycle of 14 days. The continuous intravenous infusion by using venous pump can improve the compliance.

armGroups.label: Endostar continuous intravenous infusion
armGroups.description: Endostar continuous intravenous infusion in combination with docetaxel/carboplatin or pemetrexed/carboplatin

interventions.name: Endostar
interventions.description: continuous intravenous infusion Endostar,7.5mg/m2, continuous intravenous infusion for 14 days each cycle, 21 days as one cycle, 4 cycles in total.

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: docetaxel is 75 mg/m2 intravenously over 1 hour on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: carboplatin is administered on Day 1 of each 21-day，followed by docetaxol or pemetrexed

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: pemetrexed is 500 mg/m2 intravenously on Days 1 of each 21-day cycle

primaryOutcomes.description: objective response rate based on Recist 1.1 edition

locations.facility: Affiliated Cancer Hospital & Institute of Guangzhou Medical University
